review_mode: CPU-only independent manual semantic/configuration review plus static record checks; no generated test outputs viewed or used.

findings.finding: Both hands raised forward to chest level, inward/facing palms, brief hold and lowering are near-equivalent to the held-out facing-palms chest pose. Convergence distance is not sufficiently explicit to establish separation.
findings.recommendation: Conservatively exclude this one configuration and all eight surface variants before export. Do not alter the frozen test.
evidence: Lift both arms forward until both hands reach chest level, with palms turned inward; hold briefly, and return to rest.
Bring both hands toward one another in front of the chest, palms facing each other, but leave a visible gap. Pause for one second and lower them.

findings.finding: An initial lift followed by repeat the lift three times can mean four lifts, while the intended repeated configuration appears to be three.
findings.recommendation: State three complete lifts in total, each followed by lowering. Add explicit total count=3 metadata.
findings.example: Lift the left arm forward until the left hand reaches chest level, with the palm turned inward; lower again and repeat the lift three times.

findings.recommendation: Use make one slow/gentle/quick nod, or nod once with the specified pace.
findings.example: Make 1 slow nods of the head and then look forward again.

findings.finding: A single arm is asked to indicate a direction out to the sides (plural), without specifying its own side.
findings.recommendation: Use out to the left side for the left arm and out to the right side for the right arm; both arms may use out to the sides.
findings.example: Slowly extend the left arm to indicate a direction out to the sides, pause, and bring the left hand back.

findings.finding: Point configurations give direction and tempo but omit hand height, elbow/palm orientation and total count. Some valid realizations can coincide with reserved shoulder-level arm poses.
findings.recommendation: Specify a deliberate non-reserved endpoint/height and palm/arm shape for forward/outward configurations, or explicitly document that these are broad atomic-action overlaps rather than claiming strict full-semantic disjointness.

findings.finding: Manifest configurations.description retains the pre-normalization grammar while exported rows include singular-palm/verb corrections.
findings.recommendation: Treat row text as the feature input and record its hash; consider exposing resolved_description in manifest for review.

findings.finding: Pure one-arm overhead raises are skipped, but high one-handed waves and some combinations still contain the overhead primitive. They are not complete equivalents of the frozen raise-and-lower-only cases.
findings.recommendation: Keep them if primitive sharing is intended, but do not claim all single-arm-overhead motion is unseen in training.

clear_distinctions_preserved: Nod counts 1/3/4 versus held-out 2; shake counts 2/3/4 versus held-out 1.
Torso repeated cycles and head tilt side/amplitude/count differ from the reserved configurations.
Right-then-left head sequence differs explicitly in order from held-out left-then-right; this is shared-primitives compositional generalization.
Waist/face alternating arm sequences and repeated rounds differ from held-out left-then-right single shoulder-level raises.
limitation: No broad automated signature check can establish semantic disjointness for continuous/fuzzy targets. Eight templates are eight surface forms of one configuration, not eight independent actions. This review does not establish observed motion quality.
